comment: SPEC-023 §Operational §12 (debt #112). The licences a production dependency of the services, the dashboard or the agent may carry: permissive ones, which ask for the notice alone. A package named below is admitted under the licence it names, and only that one, for the reason given. A change to this file is a reviewed change.

packages.name: caniuse-lite
packages.reason: Browser-support data that Next reads at build time; attribution, which NOTICE-style reports give.

packages.name: thirty-two
packages.reason: otplib's base32 codec. Its package.json declares no licence; its LICENSE.txt is the MIT licence (Copyright (c) 2011, Chris Umbel).

packages.name: @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64
packages.reason: libvips, a shared library sharp loads, which Next depends on for image optimisation; LGPL, dynamically linked and replaceable, its notice and source available upstream.

packages.name: @img/sharp-libvips-linuxmusl-x64
packages.reason: As @img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64, for the musl build the dashboard image's base uses.

packages.name: @img/sharp-win32-x64
packages.reason: sharp's Windows build, which carries libvips (LGPL) beside sharp (Apache-2.0); installed on a Windows developer's checkout.
